test_title: PYST 04: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’

A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A × B means ‘A is the wife of B’ and

A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is M related to Q if ‘M + N ÷ O × P – Q’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

Given: M + N ÷ O × P – Q

M + N → M is the mother of N.

N ÷ O → N is the father of O.

O × P → O is the wife of P.

P – Q → P is the brother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9fa4095272a2de3d3d77ec6f0f66c7224b5a08675508e9135ef36e2c203554f.png] 

Thus, M is Q's brother's wife's father's mother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
